verdict.rationale: Motion's marketing describes several in-product AI insights drawn from the user's own work data. It highlights your #1 priority, warns about at-risk tasks and off-track projects ahead of deadlines, predicts project completion from team capacity, and offers an AI search assistant and a notetaker that suggests action items. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how these insights are generated, any independent or hands-on corroboration that they work as claimed, and evidence of free-form or conversational analysis beyond preset alerts.
